children: said that topline phase 2 results for its amylin analogue petrelintide showed that the candidate achieved significant weight reduction and A1C improvement compared to placebo.

The ZUPREME-2 trial enrolled 220 individuals who are overweight or obese and have type 2 diabetes. Subcutaneous injections were given weekly, with those in the two petrelintide arms having their dosage increased every four weeks.

Results showed that after 28 weeks, those in the petrelintide groups saw up to 9.2% weight loss compared to 2% for those on placebo. At the same time, those in the active treatment cohort saw a decline of up to 0.65% in A1C compared to an increase of 0.23% with placebo.
Patients who discontinued treatment due to gastrointestinal side effects were 1.9% in those on petrelintide vs. 1.7% with placebo.

have begun a Phase 3a program composed of three trials: ZUPREME-3, ZUPREME-4, and ZUPREME-5 that will enroll ~7,000 participants. The trials will evaluate, respectively, weekly petrelintide vs. placebo in people with obesity or overweight without type 2 diabetes; people with obesity or overweight with type 2 diabetes; and people with obesity or overweight and established cardiovascular disease.

title: Zealand, Roche release phase 2 topline data for amylin analogue petrelintide
